# Ironguard IT

> High-accountability managed IT, security, and infrastructure partner for growing,
> multi-site companies (50-500 employees) in energy, engineering, construction, and
> technology. Tagline: "IT that takes ownership."

Pricing is public: it starts at $150 per user per month, with most multi-site engagements landing between $150 and $200 once scoped. Ironguard supports companies everywhere; home markets: New York metro, SF Bay Area, San Diego, covering
employee support, a security baseline (identity, MFA, endpoints, email), Microsoft 365
administration, device lifecycle, vendor management, and executive reporting.
Dedicated onsite coverage, hardware, travel, and major projects are scoped separately.

Ironguard is a team-based provider — leadership, IT operations and support, plus a
vetted contractor bench — with vendor partnerships across Microsoft, Google, AWS,
Dell, Lenovo, Cisco, and Meraki. A monthly license and spend review is included in
managed service; a recent cellular-carrier consolidation saved a client roughly
$15,000 per year. AI governance and AI spend analysis are core offerings.
